intents.title: My network becomes my wealth-building machine
intents.statement: The founder's master plan: a Universally Adaptive Team of eight roles runs an Income Streams Loop and a Team Loop through Phases 1-3 so that the founder's network produces recurring income.
intents.source: Founder chat in session session_012idQXWUrVAMHPo3iZpSfmv (summarized, not verbatim; chat text is intent evidence, not founder authentication)
intents.intended_outcome: Verified net cash collected from paying customers, trailing 30 days; leading indicator: paid pre-commitments within 14 days of first buyer contact.
intents.rationale: Kernel INTENT-0030: the wealth-machine language is an effect specification, compiled in docs/MASTER_PLAN_EFFECT_COMPILATION.md.
conflicts: WMI-UAT-008: draft PR #15 already specifies a Universally Adaptive Team for WMI
evidence_refs: runs/uat briefs (git-ignored): 0 paid commitments so far
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez decides; WMI maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: First paid commitment, or 30 days after the first approved buyer test with none.
unresolved_questions: Which canonical UAT design owns this outcome (see WMI-UAT-008)?

intents.title: Run the plan as an all-agent workflow
intents.statement: Adapt the master plan into a workflow run entirely by agents.
intents.source: Founder chat in session session_012idQXWUrVAMHPo3iZpSfmv (summarized, not verbatim; chat text is intent evidence, not founder authentication)
intents.intended_outcome: Each role is performed by an agent; a deterministic governor decides; humans authorize consequences.
intents.rationale: Agents propose; only the governor and the founder decide.
evidence_refs: two live runs recorded in PR #43 (64 agents)
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez decides; WMI maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: A role the agents cannot perform to acceptance.

intents.title: Build it inside WealthMachine and run it live, production-ready

intents.rationale: Superseded the Grok group-chat implementation form; its mechanisms were extracted.

intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez decides; WMI maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: Target hardware and private ledger path supplied.

intents.title: Two UAT designs in WMI
intents.statement: Draft PR #15 (2026-07-18) specifies the Universally Adaptive Team as a twelve-parent-agent enterprise operating system for WMI; PR #43 (2026-10-22) implements the founder's later eight-role master plan as runnable code. Both claim the same intended effect.
intents.source: Founder chat in session session_012idQXWUrVAMHPo3iZpSfmv (summarized, not verbatim; chat text is intent evidence, not founder authentication)
intents.intended_outcome: One canonical UAT owner, with the other's useful mechanisms integrated and the rest dispositioned.
intents.rationale: Kernel START_HERE: search open PRs for the same effect before implementing; founder 2026-11-11: every substantial component gets a documented disposition. PR #43 was built before this search.
conflicts: PR #15 spec/uat/v1 vs PR #43 src/services/uat_*.py and src/swarm/
